lastCompletedStory.title: Add a recovery-runbook scenario for the orchestrator agent-allowlist hook

nextStoryContext: US-005 added scenario (q) CAM-91 to docs/recovery-runbook.md. The scenario covers: symptom (orchestrator plan flow blocked / Task spawn denied), cause (the PreToolUse allowlist hook .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh registered in .claude/settings.json), diagnosis (read permissionDecisionReason, test the hook by hand), and how to extend the allowlist when a new sanctioned subagent is added (edit both runtime and template copies, bump the case statement, regenerate embed-vendor). Allowlist members are subagent-planner and subagent-auditor. The scenario follows the existing ### Background / ### Diagnosing / ### Manual override structure. No code was changed in this story; typecheck and all 1392 tests remain green.
